crossRefs.note: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.

translations.web: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.
translations.bsb: In this way he made the ten stands, each with the same casting, dimensions, and shape.
translations.kjv: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.
